title: Termwise surjective quasi-isomorphisms of simplicial abelian groups are trivial Kan fibrations
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of simplicial objects in the category of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. For a simplicial abelian group $X$ let $s(X)$ be its associated chain complex, with $s(X)_n=X_n$ for $n\geq0$, $s(X)_n=0$ for $n<0$, and differential $\sum_{i=0}^n(-1)^id_i:X_n\to X_{n-1}$; $f$ induces a morphism of chain complexes $s(f):s(X)\to s(Y)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. Assume that $f_n:X_n\to Y_n$ is surjective for every $n\geq0$ and that $H_n(s(f))$ is an isomorphism for every $n$. Then the map of underlying simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] is a trivial Kan fibration [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration].
